# 🔑 Workshop Materials & Workflows

This page contains links to the specific Vandalizer instance and pre-built workflows for the NCURA workshop.

## 🔗 Vandalizer Workshop Instance

You must have this instance open to import the workflows listed below.

[Vandalizer Workflow Instance Link $\rightarrow$](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/){target="_blank"}

***

## 🛠️ Sample Workflows to Import

Click the links below to instantly add these pre-built workflows to your **ncura1** Vandalizer workspace.

1.  **RFA Checklist Maker**
    * *Description:* Input: RFA | Output: A structured checklist with key information extracted from an RFA
    * [Import Workflow Link](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fc38476292df6997bb5c){target="_blank"}

2.  **Award Notice Compliance Analysis**
    * *Description:* Input: Federal Award Notices | Output: Post-award summary of compliance terms and financial requirements
    * [Import Workflow Link](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fde8476292df6997bb69){target="_blank"}

3.  **Federal Financial Report (FFR) Requirements**
    * *Description:* Input: Federal Award Notices | Output: An actionable guide that isolates all FFR and financial reporting obligations
    * [Import Workflow Link](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fe56476292df6997bb6f){target="_blank"}

4.  **Subaward Summary Generator**
    * *Description:* Input: Federal Award Notice | Output: Details on submission schedules, systems, required data, and compliance rules
    * [Import Workflow Link](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fec5476292df6997bb74){target="_blank"}

5.  **Prior Approval Requirements Tracking Summary**
    * *Description:* Input: Federal Award Notice | Output: A comprehensive tracking summary that isolates prior approval requirements
    * [Import Workflow Link](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906ff64476292df6997bb7e){target="_blank"}
